title: Tennant Company Publishes 2026 (FY25) Sustainability Report
summary: Tennant Company (NYSE: TNC), a world leader in designing, manufacturing, and marketing solutions that create a cleaner, safer, and healthier world, today published its 2026 (FY25) Sustainability Report, highlighting continued progress and a strengthened approach to delivering long-term impact. The report reflects Tennants ongoing efforts to integrate sustainability into its business while strengthening the companys approach to governance, data quality, and execution. Over the past year, Tennant focused on building a more consistent and disciplined approach, including strengthening governance, improving data quality and reliability, and increasing alignment across teams and priorities. These efforts are helping establish a stronger foundation for delivering measurable, long-term impact. The report also outlines continued progress across key areas, including: Investing $2 million in our communities through our social impact and corporate giving
